purpose: W4-B: expose safe laboratory admission, add provider-neutral VerificationOrder orchestration over the existing Service Marketplace and lab authority, and enforce explicit reject/retest/adjustment outcomes instead of advancing FAILED laboratory results to QUALITY_ACCEPTED.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue the supplied PC-CROP post-registration specification with existing push/PR/merge authorization. Implementation remains blocked until this finite scope is independently accepted and promoted into immutable base-state authority.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: Existing Service Marketplace remains the request/quote/provider/payer authority. VerificationOrder references it; W4-B must not duplicate it.
Deal transitions are consumed through existing command authority; W4-B must not create a second Deal writer. A later accepted adapter may map verified outcomes into Deal decisions.
First provider-neutral orchestration foundation can remain unmounted; only existing LabsController gains safe admission exposure.
Global CI remains an independent gate.
Generic additive migration checker remains unchanged.

requiredInvariants: Reuse the existing PostgreSQL lab sample/custody/test/signed-protocol authority and Service Marketplace; do not create LabV2, SurveyorV2 or a second provider marketplace.
VerificationOrder is provider-neutral and pins subject type/id, requested fact dimensions, methodology/version, evidence requirements, provider/service request reference and requester organization.

LAB and SURVEYOR are provider capabilities/methods, not special hard-coded transaction engines. New verification provider types can be added through the existing provider/capability model without core Deal changes.
Safe sample admission is exposed only after current tenant, Deal/lot scope, selected lab organization, actor eligibility, capacity/admission evidence and idempotency are validated server-side.

A FAILED or CONFLICT laboratory result must never advance a Deal or trust fact to accepted/verified by default. Outcomes are explicit VERIFIED, REJECTED, RETEST_REQUIRED, ADJUSTMENT_PROPOSED, UNDER_REVIEW or CONFLICT_DETECTED according to pinned policy.

Retest creates a new linked VerificationOrder/attempt and preserves the prior failed protocol/evidence. Adjustment proposals are non-binding commercial facts until separately accepted by authorized Deal parties.
Signed laboratory protocol remains immutable. New analysis or correction creates a superseding protocol/version; history is never rewritten.
Manual upload/provider self-assertion cannot manufacture independent verification. Provenance, custody chain, provider identity, method and signed protocol must satisfy the pinned evidence policy.
Current membership/user/organization/provider authority is revalidated before command and replay; revocation cannot replay an old accepted receipt as current authority.
Same-tenant outsiders and cross-tenant actors cannot read private verification orders, samples, evidence or outcomes except explicitly authorized requester/provider/Deal participants.
Every orchestration mutation commits aggregate, event, audit and outbox atomically with payload-bound idempotency and optimistic versioning.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, Progressive Trust, Inventory, Service Marketplace, packages/lockfiles and production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: API/PostgreSQL tests prove safe admission is unreachable without valid current authority and becomes reachable through the existing lab authority when all prerequisites are present.
A FAILED test/protocol produces REJECTED/RETEST_REQUIRED/ADJUSTMENT_PROPOSED according to pinned policy and never implicitly produces QUALITY_ACCEPTED or VERIFIED.
Retest links to the failed attempt, preserves old evidence, and can independently produce a later verified outcome without rewriting history.
Provider-neutral VerificationOrder works with LAB and SURVEYOR capability fixtures without changing Deal core or Service Marketplace semantics.
Cross-tenant/same-tenant outsider access, revoked actor/provider authority, stale version and changed-payload replay fail closed.
Audit/outbox/evidence failure rolls back the full orchestration mutation and no partial accepted result remains.
Existing lab custody/protocol/non-bypass suites remain green and FAILED-result regression is explicitly covered.
Forward migrations, zero public-schema drift, restore, cryptographic freshness, global CI and exact-head review pass without gate weakening.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Mounted generalized VerificationOrder API/role UX and provider comparison remain later consumer work after foundation acceptance.
Independent elevator/storage verification is a separate PHY-03 slice.
Progressive Trust must consume accepted verification outcomes before terminal fact-level verification credit.
Verified REG.RU runtime with real lab/surveyor operational acceptance remains required before terminal criteria receive PASS.
